contests.title: Narragansett town — Question 6: Fire station borrowing
contests.scopeNote: Municipal electorate named in the official sample ballot; exact held Census county subdivision, excluding similarly named CDPs and school districts.

provenance.quote: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act authorizing the Town of Narragansett to finance the equipping, expansion, improvement, and renovation of fire stations in the Town of Narragansett and to issue not more than $3,000,000 bonds and notes therefor" be approved?

measures.questionText: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act authorizing the Town of Narragansett to finance the equipping, expansion, improvement, and renovation of fire stations in the Town of Narragansett and to issue not more than $3,000,000 bonds and notes therefor" be approved?

provenance.quote: Shall an act, passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly, entitled "An Act authorizing the Town of Narragansett to finance the equipping, expansion, improvement, and renovation of fire stations in the Town of Narragansett and to issue not more than $3,000,000 bonds and notes therefor" be approved?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allow Narragansett to borrow up to $3 million through bonds and notes to equip, expand, improve and renovate town fire stations.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $3 million in borrowing for those fire station projects.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed fire station borrowing authority.
